native_loss_limits.note: Native displayed-sample loss differs from authored-density loss and is not zero.

accepted_visual_deviation: Mild flat outer tail tips at native4x, particularly on cloud backgrounds, were explicitly accepted. Native2x tips are unobtrusive; bright heads and triple separation remain clear. This acceptance does not establish seamless taper or brightness preservation.
limits: PASS is only for the frozen four component candidates and bounded preview/review. No production or publication action performed.
Keep original logical12x14 canvas, anchor0,0, whole-canvas flips before exact integer translations, and these output hashes. Expanded union is diagnostic only.
All retained nonzero RGBA samples are exact accepted-R2 samples. No compositing-order choice, added support, blending between lobes, recoloring, normalization, redraw, or generation is used.
No authored overlaps, including before crop. Neither whole-lobe multiset nor total alpha/RGB/luma preservation holds because clipping is real.

Exact footprint means fixed canvas, anchor and occupied bounds[0,1,12,13], not identity to the original indexed coverage mask. Accepted smooth R2 supports already differ from original pixel-cell coverage.
Weighted luma loss is a gamma-coded RGB proxy using2126/7152/722 coefficients, not a linear-light photometric brightness claim.
